name: clawdcursor
description: Cross-OS desktop & browser control for Claude Code, through the accessibility tree first and screenshots last — if a human can do it on a screen, your agent can too, without being told to use it. Registers the clawdcursor MCP server in compact mode and bundles its usage skill (the SKILL.md at the repo root). Requires Node.js 20+; the MCP server launches via npx, which fetches clawdcursor on demand (or uses your global install if present) — no separate install step.
